blocks.zh: Test C — 蝕刻試驗（鑑別表面處理）
blocks.en: Test C: Etching Test (Identifying Surface Treatment)

blocks.zh: Test C的設計原理
blocks.en: Design Principle of Test C

blocks.zh: Type II玻璃的高耐水解性來自「內表面處理層」（通常是硫磺化處理，形成薄薄的SiO₂富集層）。Test C先用HF/HCl混酸（1:9比例）蝕刻10分鐘，破壞這個表面處理層，然後重新做Test A。如果蝕刻後Test A結果大幅升高（5–10倍）→ 說明原本的高耐水解性依賴表面處理 → Type II。如果蝕刻後Test A結果變化不大 → 說明耐水解性來自玻璃本身組成 → Type I。
blocks.en: The high hydrolytic resistance of Type II glass comes from an "inner surface treatment layer" (usually a sulfur treatment, forming a thin SiO₂-enriched layer). Test C first etches with an HF/HCl acid mixture (1:9 ratio) for 10 minutes to destroy this surface treatment layer, and then repeats Test A. If the Test A result rises substantially after etching (5–10 times), the original high hydrolytic resistance depended on the surface treatment, so the container is Type II. If the Test A result changes little after etching, the resistance comes from the composition of the glass itself, so the container is Type I.

blocks.zh: Table 3.2.1-4判讀邏輯
blocks.en: Interpretation Logic of Table 3.2.1-4

blocks.zh: 安瓿/注射器管材的特別說明
blocks.en: Special Notes on Ampoule/Syringe Tubing

blocks.zh: 安瓿、注射器和卡匣通常由玻璃管（glass tubing）製成，通常不進行內表面處理——因為其高化學耐性來自玻璃管本身的組成（Type I材質）。因此Test C蝕刻後，結果應略低於原Test A（因部分表面被蝕除，接觸面積微減）。若出現大幅升高，則是異常情況需進一步調查。
blocks.en: Ampoules, syringes and cartridges are usually made from glass tubing and are normally not given an inner surface treatment, because their high chemical resistance comes from the composition of the glass tubing itself (Type I material). After etching in Test C, the result should therefore be slightly lower than the original Test A (part of the surface is etched away, slightly reducing the contact area). A large increase would be an abnormal situation requiring further investigation.

blocks.zh: Test C的實際應用
blocks.en: Practical Applications of Test C

blocks.zh: 供應商審核：收到新批次玻璃瓶時，若供應商CoA顯示Type II但有疑問，可運行Test C確認是否真的有表面處理。
blocks.en: Supplier audit: when a new batch of glass vials is received and the supplier CoA states Type II but there are doubts, Test C can be run to confirm whether a surface treatment is really present.

blocks.zh: 表面處理失效調查：若穩定性測試中發現異常脫層或pH偏移，可用Test C評估表面處理層是否完整。
blocks.en: Investigation of surface treatment failure: if abnormal delamination or pH shift is found in stability testing, Test C can be used to assess whether the surface treatment layer is intact.

blocks.zh: 試驗樣品再利用：允許使用做過Test A的容器做Test C，節省樣品量，特別適合小容量稀有容器。
blocks.en: Reuse of test samples: containers already used for Test A may be used for Test C, saving sample quantity, which is especially useful for small-volume, scarce containers.

blocks.zh: 砷（Arsenic）試驗
blocks.en: Arsenic Test

blocks.zh: 為何需要砷試驗？
blocks.en: Why Is an Arsenic Test Needed?

blocks.zh: 鈉鈣矽酸鹽玻璃在高溫熔製過程中，可能引入微量砷作為澄清劑（fining agent）——砷氧化物（As₂O₃）在高溫下可加速玻璃氣泡的消除。雖然現代製造已大量減少此用途，但仍有潛在風險。注射劑直接進入血液循環，砷的毒性（類金屬，致癌物）需要嚴格控制。
blocks.en: During high-temperature melting, soda-lime silicate glass may incorporate trace arsenic as a fining agent: arsenic oxide (As₂O₃) accelerates the removal of gas bubbles from the glass at high temperature. Although modern manufacturing has largely reduced this use, a potential risk remains. Injectables enter the blood circulation directly, and the toxicity of arsenic (a metalloid and carcinogen) must be strictly controlled.

blocks.zh:
砷試驗參數彙整

適用對象：含水注射用玻璃容器（Type I 和 II）
萃取液來源：Test A已高壓滅菌萃取液（121°C × 1 h）
分析方法：氫化物生成原子吸收光譜法（HG-AAS）
波長：193.7 nm
參考液範圍：0.005–0.015 ppm As
限度：≤ 0.1 ppm As
blocks.en:
Summary of Arsenic Test Parameters

Applicable to: glass containers for aqueous injections (Type I and II)
Source of extract: the autoclaved extract from Test A (121°C × 1 h)
Analytical method: hydride generation atomic absorption spectrometry (HG-AAS)
Wavelength: 193.7 nm
Reference solution range: 0.005–0.015 ppm As
Limit: ≤ 0.1 ppm As

blocks.zh: 氫化物生成AAS原理
blocks.en: Principle of Hydride Generation AAS

blocks.zh: 標準AAS對砷的靈敏度有限。「氫化物生成法（Hydride Generation）」先用KI將As(V)還原為As(III)，再以硼氫化鈉（NaBH₄）反應生成砷化氫氣體（AsH₃），導入AAS石英管中原子化偵測。此法可將偵測靈敏度提升1000倍以上，達到ppb（µg/L）級別，因此能有效偵測微量砷釋出。
blocks.en: Standard AAS has limited sensitivity for arsenic. In "hydride generation", KI first reduces As(V) to As(III), which is then reacted with sodium borohydride (NaBH₄) to form arsine gas (AsH₃); this is introduced into a quartz tube in the AAS for atomization and detection. The method improves detection sensitivity by more than 1000-fold, to the ppb (µg/L) level, so trace arsenic release can be detected effectively.

blocks.zh: 萃取液複用的設計
blocks.en: Reuse of the Extract by Design

blocks.zh: 砷試驗的試驗液直接來自Test A的萃取液——同一次高壓滅菌萃取，既可做鹼性離子滴定（耐水解性），又可做砷分析（取10.0 mL），有效節省時間和容器用量，也確保兩個試驗的萃取條件一致性。
blocks.en: The test solution for the arsenic test comes directly from the Test A extract: a single autoclave extraction can be used both for the alkali titration (hydrolytic resistance) and for arsenic analysis (10.0 mL is taken). This saves time and containers and also ensures that the extraction conditions for the two tests are consistent.

blocks.zh: 有色玻璃容器光譜透射率
blocks.en: Spectral Transmission of Coloured Glass Containers

blocks.zh: 光譜透射率試驗的目的
blocks.en: Purpose of the Spectral Transmission Test

blocks.zh: 有色玻璃（通常為棕色/琥珀色）用於保護光敏感藥品（如某些維生素、多肽類藥物）。光譜透射率試驗確認玻璃在290–450 nm（UV-近可見光範圍）的光阻擋效果——傳輸率越低，防光性越好。290 nm是藥品光降解的典型起始波長，450 nm是近可見光邊界。
blocks.en: Coloured glass (usually brown/amber) is used to protect light-sensitive drugs (such as certain vitamins and peptide drugs). The spectral transmission test confirms the light-blocking effect of the glass over 290–450 nm (UV to near-visible range): the lower the transmission, the better the light protection. 290 nm is the typical onset wavelength of drug photodegradation, and 450 nm is the boundary of the near-visible range.

blocks.zh: Table 3.2.1-5限度設計邏輯
blocks.en: Design Logic of the Table 3.2.1-5 Limits

blocks.zh: 火焰密封容器（Flame-sealed）的限度寬鬆於有密封件容器（With closures）：密封件（stopper/cap）本身可能允許微量光線透過，因此容器玻璃本身需要更嚴格的防光性補償。
blocks.en: The limits for flame-sealed containers are more lenient than for containers with closures: the closure (stopper/cap) itself may allow a small amount of light through, so the container glass itself must compensate with stricter light protection.

blocks.zh: 容量越大，限度越嚴（傳輸率越低）：大容量容器（如50 mL）壁厚較薄，玻璃層厚度不足以在每平方公分上提供足夠的光阻擋，因此需要更深的著色才能達標。小容量容器因相對壁厚較厚，允許略高的透射率。
blocks.en: The larger the volume, the stricter the limit (lower transmission): large-volume containers (such as 50 mL) have thinner walls, and the glass is not thick enough to provide sufficient light blocking per square centimetre, so deeper colouring is needed to meet the limit. Small-volume containers have relatively thicker walls and are allowed a slightly higher transmission.

blocks.zh: 樣品製備的關鍵點
blocks.en: Key Points of Sample Preparation

blocks.zh: 測試玻璃片需「代表壁厚」——不同厚度的截面光透射率不同。使用積分球（integrating sphere）是為了收集被玻璃散射的光，確保量測的是真正的透射率（而非僅直射光）。手指指紋（油脂）會在UV波段吸收光，所以用鏡頭紙擦拭後再測量。
blocks.en: The test glass pieces must be "representative of the wall thickness", because cross-sections of different thickness have different light transmission. An integrating sphere is used to collect the light scattered by the glass, so that true transmission (not just direct light) is measured. Fingerprints (grease) absorb light in the UV region, so the piece is wiped with lens tissue before measurement.

blocks.zh: CDMO注意事項
blocks.en: Points for CDMOs to Note

blocks.zh: 玻璃瓶採購時應要求供應商提供批次光譜透射率CoA，對應至相應的Table 3.2.1-5限度。
blocks.en: When purchasing glass vials, require the supplier to provide a batch spectral transmission CoA corresponding to the relevant Table 3.2.1-5 limits.

blocks.zh: 若產品標籤（label）覆蓋玻璃表面積過大，可能影響目視檢查——需在設計上確保留出足夠的無標籤區域進行可見異物目視（參考Ph.Eur. 2.9.20要求）。
blocks.en: If the product label covers too much of the glass surface, visual inspection may be affected; the design must leave a sufficient label-free area for visual inspection of visible particles (refer to the requirements of Ph.Eur. 2.9.20).

blocks.zh: 出口EU市場的注射劑需要玻璃供應商提供符合Ph.Eur. 3.2.1的測試報告，包含Type分類確認和光譜透射率數據。
blocks.en: Injectables exported to the EU market require the glass supplier to provide test reports conforming to Ph.Eur. 3.2.1, including confirmation of the Type classification and spectral transmission data.

blocks.en: Appendix: Flame Spectrometry (Alternative Method) and Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 滴定法 vs 火焰光譜法
blocks.en: Titration vs Flame Spectrometry

blocks.zh: Cs緩衝液（Spectrochemical buffer）的作用
blocks.en: The Role of the Cs Buffer (Spectrochemical Buffer)

blocks.zh: 火焰光譜法中，鉀（K）和鈣（Ca）的測量容易受其他元素（如Na）的「電離干擾（ionization interference）」影響。加入大量Cs⁺（鉮離子）可飽和火焰中的電離空間，使K和Ca保持原子態（不被電離）而能被準確量測。這是火焰AAS/AES中「釋放劑（releasing agent）」的標準作法。
blocks.en: In flame spectrometry, measurement of potassium (K) and calcium (Ca) is susceptible to "ionization interference" from other elements (such as Na). Adding a large amount of Cs⁺ (caesium ions) saturates the ionization in the flame, so that K and Ca remain in the atomic state (are not ionized) and can be measured accurately. This is the standard practice of using a "releasing agent" in flame AAS/AES.

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur. 3.2.1 — 完整測試路徑總結
blocks.en: Ph.Eur. 3.2.1: Summary of the Complete Test Pathway

blocks.zh: Ph.Eur. 3.2.1 vs USP <660> 比較
blocks.en: Ph.Eur. 3.2.1 vs USP <660> Comparison

blocks.zh: 分類體系相同：Type I（硼矽酸鹽）、Type II（表面處理鈉鈣玻璃）、Type III（普通鈉鈣玻璃）在Ph.Eur.和USP中定義一致。
blocks.en: Same classification system: Type I (borosilicate), Type II (surface-treated soda-lime glass) and Type III (ordinary soda-lime glass) are defined consistently in Ph.Eur. and USP.

blocks.zh: 試驗方法差異：Ph.Eur. Test A使用0.01 M HCl滴定；USP <660>的Surface Glass Test同樣使用0.02 M H₂SO₄，限度設定略有不同。光譜透射率試驗兩者相似但限度表格有細微差異。
blocks.en: Differences in test methods: Ph.Eur. Test A uses titration with 0.01 M HCl; the Surface Glass Test in USP <660> likewise uses 0.02 M H₂SO₄, with slightly different limits. The spectral transmission tests of the two are similar, but the limit tables differ slightly.

blocks.zh: 額外試驗：USP <660>亦包含Type IV的定義（一般用途玻璃，非注射用），Ph.Eur.對此無明確型別。
blocks.en: Additional tests: USP <660> also includes a definition of Type IV (general-purpose glass, not for injectables), for which Ph.Eur. has no explicit type.

blocks.zh: 出口全球市場的產品需同時符合Ph.Eur. 3.2.1和USP <660>，建議在容器驗證時同步確認兩個藥典的要求。
blocks.en: Products exported to the global market must comply with both Ph.Eur. 3.2.1 and USP <660>; it is recommended to confirm the requirements of both pharmacopoeias at the same time during container validation.
